FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?keyword), LCASE("EUROPEAN"))) } UNION { ?publication <https://schema.org/name> ?title . FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?title), LCASE("EUROPEAN"))) } } GROUP BY ?author ?authorName ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?publication)) LIMIT 1
